info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Product Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Product Training Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information regarding specific product training sessions based on a unique identifier. This endpoint provides insights into available training programs and resources for various products, assisting businesses in enhancing their employees' skills and product knowledge. Typical consumers include training managers and HR teams looking to streamline employee development within their organizations. By querying with the specified parameter, users can quickly find relevant training information to support their operational needs.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the specific training details for the product identified by its ID. Use this to access training materials, modules, and other resources associated with the product.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch details for the specific product training identified by PROD-700045. It contains the necessary parameters to query and retrieve the relevant product management information.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the product training data is returned.
